address: Lys Martagon, 464 route de Bellecôte, Courchevel 1850, Courchevel, 73120, France
bio: Set in a luxury boutique hotel, this restaurant with its panoramic window boasts an Art deco-inspired decor: vintage light fittings, glass roof panels and a superb collection of Lalique vases. Comfortably seated in a chic yet cosy dining room, diners can sample a lineup of dishes in the zeitgeist lovingly crafted from first-class ingredients. Highly appealing wine list....
